heroImage.prompt: Studio product photography of a glass bottle with professional rim lighting, clean background, sharp focus, 8k

sections.heading: The Anatomy of a High-End Packshot
sections.body: A great packshot is defined by three things: Sharpness, Material accuracy, and Lighting. In 'Studio Mode', our AI emphasizes these elements. You can specify materials like 'Frosted Glass' or 'Brushed Metal' to ensure the AI renders reflections with physical accuracy.

sections.heading: Customizing Studio Lighting
sections.body: Lighting can change the entire personality of a product. 'Rim Lighting' adds a premium look for high-end objects, while 'Softbox' lighting is perfect for everyday essentials. Experiment with different rigs in the 'Pro' settings for ultimate control.
